description.narrative:
1.Middle/operational management of (medium-sized) domestically-owned companies active in: a) Breeding & hatching (breeder farms, hatcheries). b) Farming (broiler farms, layer farms). c) Feed production (ingredients storage, premixes/concentrates, complete/compound feed). d) Processing facilities (transport, slaughterhouses, further processing facilities, waste water treatment).
2.Potential Bangladeshi entrepreneurs and investors active in/considering to enter the poultry sector: a) Related projects and support services. b) Local financial institutions.
3.Government and ministries
4.Poultry related associations
5.Knowledge Institutes
6.Local sector experts
7.Bangladeshi consumers of poultry meat and eggs

Development and implementation of social media and online campaign (blogs on poultry, sharing of results), resulting in regular online project updates on project progress to increase awareness on the project activities, impact cluster partners, their products, innovations and involvement in the cluster.

The overall objective is to improve the recognition of the Dutch expertise in the fields of poultry and differentiation towards other competitors. This will require an integral communication plan that focusses on the identified public and private stakeholders with direct or future involvement in the poultry sector in Bangladesh. The communication strategy and corresponding marketing materials will be developed in collaboration with NL Branding.
